findings.title: WAEC practice marking accepts unissued, cross-subject and duplicate items and replays before mastery writes
findings.cosVerified: CONFIRMED and wider than reported on e5d89c34f: gradePracticeSession looks items up by id with no subjectId filter (cross-subject items score and write mastery for their strands); duplicate ids count repeatedly; no server-issued attempt or replay binding; the review returns correctIndex, so a learner can replay the same items with known answers and inflate mastery via updateMasteryProfile.

findings.acceptance: Server-issued attempt pins student, school, subject, grade and question ids; scoring exactly once; duplicates, unissued, cross-subject ids and replays rejected; assistance provenance retained; existing practice flow still works for honest learners.
findings.schemaNote: If the repair needs a new Prisma model, stop and request schema approval (migration runbook + migration-validator); prefer a signed, expiring issued-attempt token with no schema change.
findings.decision: CoS (academic integrity) 2026-10-23: signed, expiring exact-item token (HttpOnly subject-scoped cookie; no secret or answer key in the payload); exactly one AssessmentAttempt receipt per issued attempt, made race-safe without a schema change by a deterministic namespaced receipt primary key derived from a server-random issued attempt id (atomic create; P2002 -> 409; COS-ATLAS-WAEC-RECEIPT-ACCEPTED.md); a missing or empty signing secret fails closed with 503; honest practice score/review with assistance metadata; NO admission into legacy MasteryProfile until independent evidence binding is verified (same boundary as adaptive submit PROVISIONAL_UNBOUND). Reversible: re-admission needs a separate owner decision on lib/mastery/masteryService.ts.
progress: Atlas reproduced: unissued answers update legacy mastery; the same request twice gives two updates; duplicate ids count twice; a foreign-subject item is accepted (CODEX-ATLAS-TRIAGE-CHECKPOINT.md).
